model_role: You are a Senior Frontend Engineer specialized in Creative UI/UX
task:
Develop a responsive, single-page personal portfolio website.
Section 1: Hero / Intro - Layout: Centered or split layout. - Elements: Round rect profile picture (placeholder), Name (H1), Brief Bio (short paragraph). - Socials: LinkedIn button/link styled as a terminal command.
Section 2: Project Highlights - Layout: Grid of cards. - Card Design: White background cards with soft shadows, contrasting against the page background. - Content: Title, Description, Tech Stack tags. - Interactive Element: Image Carousel/Slider within the card for project screenshots. - Navigation: Left/right arrow buttons and dot indicators at the bottom - Arrow Buttons: Dark slate background (rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)), blue icons (#3b82f6), rounded square (8px border-radius), positioned at left/right edges - Dot Indicators: 8px circles with blue theme (rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4) background, blue border), active dot scales 1.5x with glow effect - Behavior: Wraps around (last slide → first, first → last)
Card 2: Male Incontinence Solution - Project: Incontimend - Novel integrated solution for male incontinence. - Description: Developed novel medical device for male stress urinary incontinence by partnering with clinicians and a local seamstress. Prototyping 5 pressure system designs with Fusion 360, testing 10+ fabrics including bamboo and spandex. Published patent review on Translational Andrology and Urology. - Tech Stack: 3D Printing, Fusion 360, Fabric Prototyping, Patent Research, FDA Compliance - Images: - Design day poster: assets/dt/poster.png - Team members professional photo: assets/dt/team.jpg - Mosaic of team members: assets/dt/mosaic.png - Link: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11399061/
Card 3: B-Player - Project: B-Player - Desktop Music Player - Description: Music player based on Bilibili — A modern desktop music player with library management, playlist support, and seamless music importing from web sources - Tech Stack: Electron, React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, SQLite, yt-dlp, Tailwind CSS, Vite - Images: Placeholder images (to be replaced with actual screenshots) - Link: https://github.com/zydtiger/b-player
Card 4: Knowledge Tree Tauri App - Project: LearnForge - Learning Goal Management and Logging App - Description: A comprehensive app for managing and tracking learning goals with a captivating "skill tree" interface. Features goal management, progress logging with markdown support, and category-based organization for skills across different domains. - Tech Stack: Tauri, React, TypeScript, Vite, Ant Design, Electron - Images: Load from https://github.com/zydtiger/LearnForge raw repository: - Tree View Demo: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zydtiger/LearnForge/dev/.github/tree-view-demo.png - List View Demo: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zydtiger/LearnForge/dev/.github/list-view-demo.png - Note View Demo: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zydtiger/LearnForge/dev/.github/note-view-demo.png - Link: https://github.com/zydtiger/LearnForge
Design System ("Code-like" Theme): - Typography: 'Maple Mono' as the primary font for headings, UI elements, and code snippets. Sans-serif fallback. - Headings: Prefixed with a primary-colored '$' and formatted in snake_case (e.g., `$ about_me`, `$ my_projects`). - Background: Deep blue/purple gradient (e.g., mimicking a dark mode IDE theme or terminal background). - Animations: Smooth scroll reveal animations for sections. Hover effects on cards (scale or border highlight).
constraints: - Tech Stack: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript (no heavy frameworks unless necessary). - Responsiveness: Mobile-first approach. Cards should stack on smaller screens. - Accessibility: Semantic HTML tags, proper ARIA labels for the slider, sufficient color contrast. - Assets: Use standard placeholder images (e.g., via placehold.co or simple SVG patterns) if user assets aren't provided. - Code Quality: Clean, commented, and modular CSS/JS.
